2. Lender commitment amounts and percentages ✓ (captured)
3. Note amounts for each lender ✓ (captured in commitment structure)
4. Next redetermination date of December 1, 2023 ✓ (captured)
5. Parties involved (borrower and lenders) ✓ (captured)

The source document is an amendment that modifies specific terms of an existing credit agreement rather than establishing all terms from scratch.
